sb_prompt: PLEASE DISCUSS TYPES OF VACATIONS AND TRIPS YOU ENJOY.  FIND OUT WHETHER THE OTHER CALLER CAN INTEREST YOU IN A VACATION SPOT YOU HAVEN'T VISITED.
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hey, how's it going?
ParticipantB: Pretty good, just heading down the I-95. What are you up to?
ParticipantA: Just wrapping up a shift at the diner here. It's been one of those crazy busy nights.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I know that feeling. I was out on the road yesterday, stuck in traffic for three hours near the border.
ParticipantA: Wow, that sounds miserable. I guess I'm used to it; customers come in hungry any time of day.
ParticipantB: Right, but I prefer the open road. Got to see stuff you never see from a kitchen window.
ParticipantA: True. I actually just took a few days off last week and drove up to Vermont.
ParticipantB: Oh, nice! I've got a buddy, his name is Dave, who's a fisherman up there. He told me the water is crazy clear right now.
ParticipantA: Really? That sounds amazing. I haven't been to Vermont yet, but I hear the food is terrible up there.
ParticipantB: Haha, yeah, honestly? The only good thing is the scenery and the air. The places with fancy food are overpriced and small.
ParticipantA: Oh, you're probably right. I usually end up making a mess in the kitchen anyway, so I prefer eating where it's cheap.
ParticipantB: Exactly, that's why I'm thinking maybe I should go visit Dave next month. He's got a tiny shack on Lake Champlain.
ParticipantA: A shack? That sounds perfect. I like simple stuff. Do you fish or just hang out?
ParticipantB: Mostly just sit on the dock and watch the water, maybe grab a beer. It's real quiet there.
ParticipantA: I love quiet. I never find it anywhere else. Sometimes I just want to sit by the river and not talk to anyone.
ParticipantB: That sounds peaceful. I'd trade my truck for that for a weekend. What did you do in Vermont besides eat?
ParticipantA: Oh, I hiked a little bit. There's this trail near Montpelier, it's pretty steep but the view is worth it.
ParticipantB: A hike? Wow, I thought you were all about the low-key stuff. I bet your legs are killing you now.
ParticipantA: Yeah, they are! But the air is so fresh, it makes it worth it. Maybe I should try a lake trip sometime.
ParticipantB: For sure. If you ever go to the lake, give me a call. I can show you the best spots to throw a line.
ParticipantA: I'd love that. Maybe I'll plan a trip up there in the fall, when the leaves are changing.
ParticipantB: That sounds great. Fall is my favorite time, the light is just different.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I've heard that. Alright, I've got another table calling.
ParticipantB: Okay, keep me in mind if you end up near the lake. Drive safe.
ParticipantA: Will do. Take care, bye.
ParticipantB: Bye.
